flags.message: Band `elevated` here rests on distribution_count=2, but the first distribution (Conference of 5/1/2026) was superseded by a response request on 4/22/2026 and never reached conference; the petition's first actual consideration is the 9/28/2026 long conference. The docket's real signal is a called-for-response after a government waiver, which the scorer does not read, while the relist it does read is the reschedule-before-consideration artifact the statpack's relist caption already names. Not a defect in the cell; noted so the band-vs-trajectory mismatch is visible when this cell is scored against the elevated reached rate.
